name: @airness/payload
description: The Payload gates of the Airness Payload stack, the stack defaults the node gates read, and the Payload ESLint configuration.
author: Herman Ciechanowiec <herman@ciechanowiec.eu>

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.package:reproducible: pnpm run build && pnpm pack --pack-destination target/repack && node ../airness-node/scripts/package/compare-packs.ts target target/repack

securityOverrides.reason: The database adapter reaches the old esbuild-kit loader through drizzle-kit; this patched release retains its transform API and satisfies the Vite optional peer used by verification.
The Payload code editor pins a vulnerable DOMPurify patch; the corrected patch retains the sanitizer API.
The Payload rich-text dependency still requests happy-dom 20; its optional DOM entry uses the same Window API from the corrected release.

coverageExclude.reason: the executable's entry point, which runs only as a process of its own; the command line it starts is measured
read only by the shipped access-boundary specification, inside a Playwright worker started in a Payload application; the decisions it feeds are measured in access-boundary.ts
the Payload template selectors are consumed by the browser adapter inside Playwright; the real Payload browser fixture proves which content is scanned

vulnerabilityAllowlist.reason: deepmerge reaches this package only through payload, a development dependency that the Local API catalogue specification reads to compare the catalogue with the operations BasePayload declares; nothing here merges an object an outsider supplies, and the published package carries neither payload nor deepmerge.
vulnerabilityAllowlist.mitigation: No release fixes the advisory: deepmerge 4.3.1 is the last affected and the latest version, and payload 3.93.0 still depends on it. Remove this entry once payload drops deepmerge or a fixed deepmerge is released.
